content: Rubruub to Yosep ilale

Yosep tomania tooghŋa ve taazi tighanghan le isov, ra i isaav pa besooŋa tooni tau iŋgin ruum tooni na ighe: “Unonogh aniiŋ izila nakaral toozi lolozi le tivoniir, ve ughur tamtamon eŋaeŋa maet toozi imuul izila nakaral toozi avozi.
Ve ugham rubruub tsiau tau tigharaata pa silva na, tomania maet to ŋeer muria, ve ughuru izila nakaral tooni aavo.” Tauvene besooŋa tawe ila igham gabua itaghon Yosep aliiŋa.
Tigheen le nughizau, ra yes besooŋa to Yosep tighur Yosep tooghŋa ve taazi tomania doŋki toozi gha timuul tila.

Yes tipul nugh tiina, ve tilaagh tila rig, ra Yosep isaav pa besooŋa tooni tau iŋgin ruum tooni na ighe: “Uburig ve ulaan taghon zi ula. Saawe tau uzaa toozi, usaav pazi ughe: ‘Ai, tiina tsiau itotoi ŋgar poia payam. Puughu mindai ta ayoli pa ŋgar saghati?
Yam aum rubruub tooni tau i ighunghun pani, ve ighitghita gabua tau murei pale ivot. Ŋgar tau aghamu na, ene saghati kat!’”
Yosep isavsaav pani le isov, ra besooŋa tawe iburig gha ilaan itaghon Yosep tooghŋa ve taazi ila, le izaa toozi. Ra isavia Yosep aliiŋa pazi.
Yes tilooŋ saveeŋ tooni, ve tiyol aliiŋa tighe: “Wai tiina, yo ughit ghei mindai, ta ugham saveeŋ tauvene payei? Yei besooŋa tsio irau nigham ŋgar eta tauvena mako. Mako le mako kat!

Ughita. Saawe tau nimuul nila nivot taan Kanaan ve nikaak nakaral tsiei, yei nirur pa maet tsiei isov ighenaar izila nakaral tsiei avozi. Eemon maet tawe, nighamu imuul ilat wa. Tauvene pale nium silva ve gol ila ruum to tiina tsio loolo pasaa?
Tiina, ighe yo undeeŋ rubruub tawe igheen to yei tane eta, ene aat tamtamon tana imaat, ve yei siriv nimin besooŋa pa tiina tsio.”

Besooŋa tana iyol aliŋazi ighe: “Saveeŋ tsiam poia. Eemon isaav ighe nandeeŋ rubruub tana igheen to tamtamon tsiam eta, ene i zigani ta pale imin besooŋa payau. Ve yam siriv, lemim saveeŋ mako. Irau ala.”
Tauvene rekia mon yes eŋaeŋa tisur nakaral toz toz izi taan, ve tikaak avozi. Leso besooŋa tana itiir zi.
I itiir to ŋeer olman imin maata, ve itaghoni ila ila le indeeŋ rubruub tana igheen ila ŋeer muria Benyamin nakaral tooni loolo.
Tooghŋa tighita gabua tana le atezi imot. Tauta tiraŋgat nonoghiiŋa toozi, ve tiit yauyauŋ toozi izala doŋki toozi pavozi muul, ve timuul tila pa nugh tiina.
Yosep ilepleep ruum tooni, ve isasaŋan zi. Yuda tomania tooghŋa ve tazŋa tilam peria tooni muul, ve titap tizi ila Yosep naagho, ve tighur naghozi izila pa taan.
Yosep isaav pazi ighe: “Puughu mindai ta agham ŋgar tane? Yam akankaan payau? Tamtamon tau imin yau ne, i irau iwatagh gabua ŋgozaaŋa paam.”

Yuda iyol aliiŋa ighe: “Oo tiina tsiei, yei lemai saveeŋ mako. Pasaa, sosor tsiei ta igheen mataghare wa. Pale nisaav mindai? Pa aazne, Maaron tauu, ta itotoi sosor tsiei ivot ighazooŋ. Tauvene tiina, yei nisov aat nimin besooŋa payo, yeŋa tazimai tau rubruub tsio igheen tooni na.”

Eemon Yosep isaav pazi ighe: “Ee-e, irau nagham tauvene ne mako. Ŋeer tau rubruub tsiau igheen tooni na, i zigani mon ta aat ileep ve imin besooŋa payau. Ve yam siriv, amuul ala pa tamamim. Yau leg saveeŋ payam mako.”
Yuda ighason ariaaŋ ighe igham Benyamin niia
Ra Yuda ila igharau Yosep, ve isaav pani ighe: “O tiina tsiau, yau besooŋa tsio. Yo ezam tiina imin kinik tauu. Eemon naghe nasavia saveeŋ tsiau rig payo. Atem raa, yavyav payau sov.
“Muuŋ, yo ughason ghei ughe: ‘Tamamim ilepleep? Ma lemim tazimim ite paam, ma mako?’

“Ve yei niyol ghasoniiŋ tsio nighe: ‘Vee. Tiina tsiei, tamamai yesuru tazimai muria, ta tilepleep we. Tazimai tawe, tamamai imin olman, ra tiina ipoopa. Ve tinamai tawe, i ipoop natŋa ru mon. Ŋeer olman, i imaat wa. Tauvene ŋeer muria mon ta ilepleep. Tamamai ipulpuli mako. Pasaa, i loolo igheen tooni kat.’
Tiina, yo ulooŋ saveeŋ tsiei tana, tauta usaav payei ughe nigham tazimai tane ilam, leso ughita pa taum matam.
“Ve yei niyol aliŋam nighe: ‘Tazimai tawe pale irau ipul tamamai ne mako. Pa ighe ipuli, ene pale tamamai loolo isaghat pani, ve imaat.
Eemon avom iyaryaaŋ payei ughe yei aat nigham tazimai tane gha yeŋa nimuul nilam. Ighe mako, ene irau nilam peria tsio muul mako.’
“Saawe tau nimuul nila nivot to tamamai, yei nipaesia aliŋam isov tana pani.
Nilepleep le murei ra, tamamai imbaaŋ ghei muul ighe nilam tsio, ve nighol lemai aniiŋ rigta.

Tauvene yei nisaav pani nighe: ‘Tamamai, yei irau nizila sorok mako. Pa ighe yeŋa tazimai nizila mako, ene aat irau nila nivot to daaba tawe mako. Tauvene uyokia tazimai payei, o nizila. Ve ighe uŋguruuta, ene aat nileep.’
“Tauvene tamamai tau besooŋa tsio na, isaav payei ighe: ‘Yam awatagh: Azuwag Rael ipoop leg natugŋa ru mon.
Ve ee ipul ghau alok wa. Aat gabua sagsag eta ighani ila wa. Pasaa, saawe tana ve ilam, yau naghita naagho muul mako.

Aghita. Yau namin kooŋ ve moom izaa payau wa. Isaav ighe yam agham natug tane gha ala, ve pataŋani eta ivot pani izi eeze, ene pale igham lolog isaghat kat ve namaat gha nazila nugh to mateegha.’ “Tamamai aliiŋa, tauta ene.

Tauvene tiina tsiau, ughita. Tamamai, raa, imin kooŋ ve moom izaa pani. Isaav ighe namuul nala tooni, ve i ighita tazimai tane naagho mako, ene aat loolo isaghat kat ve imaat. Pasaa, loolo igheen to naatu tane kat. Ve yei tane pale nimin puughu pa mateegh tooni.

Tiina tsiau, yau taug nambu saveeŋ ariaaŋa tomania tamamai naghe yau aat matag pa tazimai tane le irau naghamu imuul ila peria tooni. Ve ighe naghamu imuul ila mako, ene aat imin leg puughu, ve nabaad saveeŋ tooni ila tamamai maata le irau saawe tsiau isov ve namaat.
Tiina, mindai? Irau upul tazig marani tane tomania tooghŋa siriv timuul tila to tamamai? Ve yau aat nagham niia, ve naleep ta sene, ve namin besooŋa payo.
Pa ighe tazig tane ilam tomani ghau mako, pale namuul nala to tamaŋ mindai? Yau lolog pa naghita pataŋani tauvene izaa tooni mako.”
